reviewed.note: c2 exact-fit review passed: the concept is the native SysML verification-case construct itself. The pinned standard library defines VerificationCases::VerificationCase as the most general class of performances of VerificationCaseDefinitions and VerificationCases::verificationCases as the base feature of all VerificationCaseUsages. The ontology description (a planned or executed check that evaluates whether a requirement or model claim is satisfied) states that specification/performance scope and the check-for-satisfaction purpose without asserting any outcome, so it is a bounded description of the native construct for DE4SDV usage; the DE4SDV verify targets are requirement usages (evidence contracts and acceptance criteria). Standard-library grounding proven for the real DE4SDV constructs (Lane B): the definition VC-AEBS-009D-DE (ConsciousOverrideVerification) carries a toolchain-materialized implied Subclassification to VerificationCases::VerificationCase and each usage VC-AEBS-009D-01..06 an implied Subsetting to VerificationCases::verificationCases; the anchors were resolved by the licensed exporter from the pinned Systems Library/VerificationCases.sysml and cross-checked in the imported closure. The API metaclass (VerificationCaseDefinition / VerificationCaseUsage) is a separate evidence field from the library grounding (UG-28): the metaclass alone is not the semantic proof. Grounding provenance: the library edges are toolchain-implied and stay visibly implied; the DE4SDV usage-to-definition typing is explicitly authored; no redundant authorship was added for the implied grounding. Claim boundary: verification-objective carrier only; no execution, outcome, evidence-maturity, or release implication. The retained Lane B exact-toolchain evidence stays supporting evidence only (not revision-bound to this inventory revision, so the evidence state stops at parity-reviewed): privileged run 34576049742 (success) at candidate 0a23902370de9fc74d6118afe480382e0b0d8aa0; artifact full-model-api-ingestion-0a23902370de9fc74d6118afe480382e0b0d8aa0.

Decomposition (docs/method-conformance/o1/c3-subject-grounding-review.md). Native core — SubjectMembership is a ParameterMembership specialization whose member is the subject parameter of the owning requirement-like usage; the native fact is subject-of-requirement and says nothing about member products. Source restriction — domain=Requirement is a DE4SDV query restriction over that native fact because Need (StakeholderNeedCandidate) and Requirement (RequirementCandidate) are sibling lineages both serialized as RequirementUsage — API metaclass equality is not ontology-class identity, and StakeholderNeedCandidate usages carry real memberProduct subjects in the model (N-AEBS-008/014, N-MW-004). Target restriction — range= MemberProduct excludes real non-product native subjects (verification benches, System 2 increments, claim subjects, acceptance criteria — all RequirementUsage-sourced SubjectMemberships in the governed model). Enforcing the restrictions is representation mechanics derived from the declared domain/range (kernel_contract exposes them on the mapping; traversal resolves both lineages through the ingestion-validated kernel bindings plus the representation-tolerant relationship graph and never consults names) — the mechanics carry no second type contract and cannot redefine domain/range. Bounded fail-closed hardening shipped with the review — subject-membership traversal now returns only Requirement- lineage-sourced, MemberProduct-lineage-targeted hops (non-qualifying native subjects are quiet absence; missing lineage bindings fail closed when qualifying candidates exist). Retained-run replay (full-model candidate export, 289 SubjectMemberships) measured the pre-c3 traversal over-returning 110 subject hops that the enforced contract rejects (57 non-Requirement sources, 53 non-MemberProduct targets) while preserving all 21 legitimate Requirement->MemberProduct hops. Claim boundary — bounded native subject relation only; the subject being a member product does not mean selection, satisfaction, realization, allocation, applicability, or any PLE configuration fact (PLE rows stay independently gated). Lane B verification SubjectMembership evidence informed the serialized shape only and does not establish this predicate. authority_current stays legacy-yaml during O1; any transition is an O3 decision. doc_observation_note: Observation values: normalized-exact (equality after purely cosmetic normalization: case/punctuation/whitespace/line wrapping; containment or substring overlap is NOT parity) | differs (material wording drift -> semantic_text_equivalence=review-required until a bounded semantic review completes, then reviewed-equivalent; fuzzy similarity is NOT parity) | doc-absent | doc-absent (bodyless declaration) | block-not-located. reviewed-equivalent is Layer-B governance metadata (not a SysML, ontology, API, or runtime value): a bounded human review found the differing direct-body documentation semantically equivalent to the authoritative definition; it is recorded only for differs observations, changes no Layer-A observation and no evidence state, and is never derived automatically. Definition-level rule: a doc comment is owned by the element whose body it lexically sits in (SysML v2 specification, Comments and Documentation). The observed text is every documentation statement at the declaration body's direct lexical depth — uniform lexical containment, in source order: position, preceding semicolon-terminated members, and the presence of an earlier direct-body doc do not change ownership; docs inside nested member bodies are never collected.
